title: AIAS Central Nervous System
purpose: Provide durable, traceable and failure-aware circulation between the digital engineering company's core systems.
scope: Topology, immutable events, global sequence, atomic journal, event identity idempotency, subscriptions, cursors, dead letters and executive projections.

requirements.title: CNS topology
requirements.statement: The system shall define producers, consumers and event contracts for core AIAS nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Durable event envelope
requirements.statement: Accepted events shall be immutable, validated, sequenced and persisted before delivery.
requirements.rationale: Prevent lost or ambiguous state changes.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Idempotency and ordering
requirements.statement: Repeated event identities shall not duplicate journal entries and consumers shall receive sequence order.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Consumer recovery
requirements.statement: Consumers shall retain monotonic cursors and failed delivery evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Company projection
requirements.statement: The system shall project delivery, recommendation, risk and credential state.
requirements.rationale: Give Dashboard and PMO an immediate CNS consumer.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: CNS shall include tests, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
